reason: No quotable live line exists: the pack carries no fresh-feed section and both matched jobs (Academic Technologist, 2026-04-15; Controller, 2026-05-04) are snapshot-only with live=None, and neither confesses a technology-governance gap — the Academic Technologist req is a faculty-facing ed-tech role and the Controller req is finance/internal-controls. The situation is also the opposite of Kenneth's niche: that same JD names a staffed in-house Technology Department ('a Network Specialist, Systems Support Specialist, A/V Specialist, and two Academic Technologists') led, per stlukesct.org/academics/learning-technology and her LinkedIn profile, by Eleanor Page, Director of IT since Dec 2017 (8.5 years) — not a school that outgrew reactive outsourced IT with no technology leadership. Size also misses: U.S. News lists 592 students in grades 5-12 versus his ~800-2,000 target band.
